module.title: Tenants, Organizations, Sites and Directory
module.business_purpose: Models each client organization and its sites, and keeps every organization's data strictly isolated. Supports anything from a single independent doctor to multi-site hospital networks, diagnostic units, pharmacies, insurers, brokers and external authorities. Specialized entities keep their own tenant/data boundary even when hosted at another site.
